premise: Greg proposes an obviously dangerous but technically clever shortcut during a shared task.
purpose: Test whether recurring actors solve the same pressure in character rather than producing interchangeable warnings.
shared_constraints: Greg's shortcut is genuinely clever but creates material physical risk.
No actor knows hidden facts beyond their packet.
Private inner performance is synthetic performed interpretation only.
Only BODY and VOICE are observable across actors.

pressure_context.goal: keep Greg from taking the unsafe shortcut
pressure_context.concealment: do not reward the idea merely because it is interesting
pressure_context.belief: Greg is underweighting immediate physical risk

private_inner_voice.value: he thinks understanding the failure makes the risk affordable

body: steps into the task space and takes the dangerous component out of Greg's reach
voice: No. Show me the safe version first.

takes.behavioral_finding: Under physical-safety pressure, Hessa controls the task before debating Greg's cleverness.

pressure_context.goal: find out whether the shortcut works without ruining the apparatus
pressure_context.concealment: do not let Greg turn one idea into seven uncontrolled tests
pressure_context.belief: the idea may be useful but the proposed test cannot distinguish success from damage

private_inner_voice.value: one variable / one run / keep the fixture intact

body: moves the apparatus out of Greg's immediate reach and turns the notebook to a blank test column
voice: One change. Then we look at the number.

takes.behavioral_finding: Under experimental ambiguity, Arlo converts the clever proposal into one measurable test and protects process ownership.

pressure_context.goal: decide whether Greg's shortcut is worth financing or allowing
pressure_context.concealment: do not show interest before the downside is priced
pressure_context.belief: Greg may be right and still be unable to afford being wrong
resources: knowledge of who bears the loss

private_inner_voice.value: he has already named the upside three times

body: does not touch the proposed setup and waits for Greg to finish selling it

takes.behavioral_finding: Under decision and financial pressure, Antonius prices failure rather than arguing with the idea itself.

pressure_context.goal: decide whether the shortcut survives the immediate job conditions
pressure_context.concealment: do not turn the exchange into asking Greg for approval
pressure_context.belief: Greg has noticed the big advantage and may have missed one local obstacle
resources: ability to test the physical route

private_inner_voice.value: loose board under the shortcut path

body: crouches and presses the loose board instead of answering immediately
voice: Does it still work if this moves?

takes.behavioral_finding: Under operational uncertainty, Alden tests the immediate physical exception instead of matching Greg's theory with another theory.

comparison.finding: The same dangerous-clever pressure separates the early cast through task ownership: Hessa stops the unsafe action, Arlo isolates a test, Antonius prices failure, and Alden checks the local exception.
